study: R4 conditional geometry-to-HiSpatial diagnostic after the direction-only gate
scope: The fixed 107 direction rows and the single selected box-only readout. Use geometry only where available, with the original no-evidence frame clarification as fallback. Existing geometry and model states are locked.
design: For the same original prompt and clock instruction, append either both object's lateral/forward coordinates or the signed A-to-B offset. In each interface compare correct versus swapped evidence. Never include an answer hour or derived angle. Use four digits after the decimal in all conditions and evaluate the direct readout from the actual rounded evidence.
controls: Same frozen HiSpatial RGB, given region rectangles, unchanged MoGe XYZ, same final clock format, same direct evidence. Correct/swapped evidence comparisons use transposed endpoints or negated relative offsets.
measurement: Clock success and angular error; paired image bootstrap vs no-evidence and same-information direct readings; answer agreement with direct evidence and 180-degree counterfactual response under swapping.
labels: The task-level gate is read as an aggregate choice only. No references or per-item performance in conditioning. Score the fixed selected cohort only after all conditional predictions are sealed.
